query: move a persistent object then attach source evidence
report_gap: npx hyperframes feedback --search-miss "move a persistent object then attach source evidence" --wanted "<the move you needed>" --tier words

results.name: yt-camera-move
results.title: Camera Punch-In
results.description: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay

results.name: thread-message-stack
results.title: Thread Message Stack
results.description: A source-owned editable conversation stack with arbitrary incoming and outgoing messages

results.name: comparison-split
results.title: Comparison Split
results.description: Two full-bleed panels compare before and after states as a persistent divider wipes the vivid after layer over the muted before layer and rests at a configurable split.

results.name: before-after-wipe
results.title: Before After Wipe
results.description: Two full-bleed content slots compare before and after states as a persistent divider wipes the after layer over the before layer and rests at a configurable split. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: focus-swap
results.title: Focus Swap
results.description: Moves attention between two side-by-side cards as one recedes with scale, blur, and dimming while the other advances to full focus.

results.name: pan-stations
results.title: Pan Stations
results.description: A lateral camera move across a continuous row of labeled feature stations, with a steady dwell at each stop before the next pan.

results.name: ascii-render-pass
results.title: ASCII Render Pass
results.description: A slotted scene renders as live ASCII: a canvas samples the source's luminance grid (rasterized once at mount) and draws glyphs from a density ramp charset; resolution steps coarse to fine as the piece resolves, then holds legible-fine.

results.name: macos-tahoe-liquid-glass
results.title: macOS Tahoe Liquid Glass Desktop
results.description: 3D MacBook with a macOS Tahoe-style desktop, glass menu bar, Finder window, dock, and cinematic device camera move.

results.name: code-morph
results.title: Code Morph
results.description: One snippet transforms into another — tokens glide between positions, leavers fade out, enterers fade in. Shiki Magic Move re-driven as a paused GSAP timeline.

results.name: radial-surround
results.title: Radial Surround
results.description: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.

results.name: telemetry-hud
results.title: Telemetry HUD
results.description: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

results.name: titlecard-lockup
results.title: Titlecard Lockup
results.description: The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.

results.name: light-sweep-pass
results.title: Light Sweep Pass
results.description: A traveling key light re-shades a slotted scene: a soft diagonal gradient band crosses the frame once while every per-element highlight and shadow shifts in lockstep (all driven by one --light-x property), then the light settles into a resting key. Quiet, expensive-feeling; the scene itself never moves. Callers fill the named scene slot; a token hero-and-cards default renders when it is left empty.

results.name: camera-dolly-zoom
results.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
results.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

results.name: facet-morph
results.title: Facet Morph
results.description: A faceted low-poly mass of 36 triangles continuously reshapes between three authored silhouettes (blob, mark, badge) with per-facet flat shading that recomputes as the vertices move. Light reads from the upper left; lit facets lift toward a pale accent-tinted tone while turned-away facets fall toward near-black. One calm continuous morph, then a settled hold.
